thread:
maria: quick check — are we aligned on v2 deprec timeline? need final owners for migration playbook and any blockers before I send the customer-facing note.

jack: I can own the SDK compatibility section. will drop PR links today. :+1:

oliver: infra has a potential blocker — the edge proxy still rewrites Authorization header for legacy endpoints. working on a fix but may need a short hotfix window.

maria: thanks. @oliver can you paste the proxy rewrite rule here? want to be explicit in the rollout notes.

oliver: here's the snippet from the proxy config:
```yaml
- match: "/v1/*"
  rewrite: "/api/legacy/{path}"
  headers:
    remove: ["Authorization"]
```

sara: re: SDKs — we have 2 outstanding PRs: 432 (python) and 289 (ts). both add shim for `create_chat` -> `chat.create` mapping. tests green locally but need review. cc @jack

jack: on it. will skim 432 now. can we also add a small migration example in docs that shows the new shape? keeps CS tickets down.

maria: yes pls. propose a short snippet in docs that we can include with the deprec email.

tim: FYI on rollout policy: ops wants to stagger by region over 48h with automatic rollback if error rate > 2% for 15m. draft policy here:
```json
{"strategy":"staggered","regions":["us-east-1","us-west-2","eu-west-1"],"watch":{"window_mins":15,"error_pct":2},"rollback":"auto"}
```

anna: small ask — analytics needs the v1->v2 mapping for event names; will someone own exporting a CSV of endpoint pairs?

maria: @jack can you add that to SDK PR checklist? quick CSV with columns: v1_path, v2_path, notes.

jack: yep, will add a generator script in the python SDK repo under tools/migrate_map.py. quick pseudo: `requests.get("/internal/mapping").json()` and dump csv.

oliver: infra-bot reports current canary capacity is 60% on us-east-1, can hold a rapid rollout but we'd prefer to do the fix first. infra-bot says: "deployed-proxies: 3/5 with new config"

infra-bot: deploy-plan note: hotfix window requested 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC for config patch.

maria: ok — plan: jack owns SDK PRs + migration CSV, oliver owns proxy fix & hotfix scheduling, tim owns rollout policy and monitoring hooks, anna will coordinate analytics export. I'll draft the customer communication once I see the SDK example.

jack: estimating PR reviews + docs + CSV generator by EOD tomorrow.

oliver: will have the proxy fix ready for canary by 2026-03-21; scheduling the hotfix as infra-bot suggested.

sara: I posted links: PR 432: https://git.company/x/sdk-python/pull/432 , PR 289: https://git.company/x/sdk-js/pull/289

maria: perfect. any blockers besides infra?

tim: one more — can we add a lightweight smoke test that hits both v1 and v2 responses to compare shapes? I can add it to the canary job.

jack: good call. adding `tests/smoke/migration_smoke.py` to the python PR. will mock tokens to avoid prod creds.

maria: great. I'll hold the external announcement until infra confirms hotfix window and SDK PRs merged. thanks all :)

oliver: noted, ping me if you want the exact diff for the rewrite rule.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for v2 endpoints in us-east-1 on 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC (pending hotfix completion).

maria: leaving thread — will update the rollout doc and tag owners there. if anything urgent ping me DMed.
